# Changelog

## 1.20.1 (package) / 1.20.0.99 (plugin) — 2026-09-10
- Config descriptions now start with their unit: `[MINUTES]` for respawn times, `[SECONDS]` for
  sapling growth times, `[ITEM COUNT]` for planting costs and yields. Key names and defaults are
  unchanged, so existing config files keep working. Source change: `Configuration/ModConfig.cs`
  string literals only.

## 1.20.0 (package) / 1.20.0.99 (plugin) — 2026-09-09
- Advize's PlantEverything 1.20.0 rebuilt against Valheim 1.0.7 with ServerSync compiled from source.
- No gameplay, config or code changes. Full source included under `source/`.
